name: 16349-longdecode-mimov2flash-tp8
model: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE. 313.1 GB of safetensors, ungated, not in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=8 with DP-attention 2: attention at TP=4 in each of two groups, MoE over all 8 ranks; EP off, PP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: MiMoV2FlashForCausalLM, 309.8 B parameters, block-wise FP8 (weight_block_size [128, 128], e4m3) -- native on Hopper. Further detail is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 400 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets: 8192 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens, both FIXED with no spread, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-context research report writer generating full-page answers for eight concurrent analysts on one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# sglang at commit bf32cd8397b867a17f71b280c508f0ef2d44555c (v0.5.7 era), eight GPUs of one
# node serving MiMo-V2-Flash.

model-path: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash

tp-size: 8

# Two DP-attention groups: attention runs at TP 4 inside each, the MoE keeps all eight ranks.
# This checkpoint's FP8 attention block scales load at attention TP 4 (its own SGLang layout), not at 8.
dp-size: 2
enable-dp-attention: true

# The checkpoint ships an auto_map pointing at its own configuration module; without this the
# server will not start.
trust-remote-code: true

attention-backend: fa3

mem-fraction-static: 0.7

# Keep this on ONE line: the engine reads this file line by line and skips indented ones, so a
# re-flowed block mapping drops the key and the server starts without it at rc=0.
model-loader-extra-config: {"enable_multithread_load": "true", "num_threads": 64}

random-seed: 42
